exact_claim_repair.maps: S(y)_j=y(u_j); Q_x=S_*P_x. For each g,k take the least N>=k with norm(g-P_Ng)<=2^-k. T(z)(g) is the finite-real limit of the corresponding basis partial sums if it exists, otherwise zero.
exact_claim_repair.measurability: Each selected partial sum is a finite linear combination of measurable coordinate evaluations. Measurable limsup/liminf yield a measurable finite-convergence set and zero-extended limit for each fixed g; hence T is cylinder-measurable. S is measurable by evaluations.
exact_claim_repair.law_identities: S_*P_x=Q_x, T_*Q_x=P_x for all x, and S∘T=id on all coefficient sequences.
exact_claim_repair.proof: The L2 error along the selected indices is at most (norm(Kx)^2+epsilon^2)4^-k. Integral Markov at each threshold 1/r and first Borel-Cantelli give almost-sure equality for each fixed x,g. Finite intersections give equality on finite cylinders; finite-measure pi-system uniqueness gives equality on the full cylinder sigma-algebra.
exact_claim_repair.boundary_and_choice: Finite bases use sums restricted to J; the empty basis gives the singleton coefficient space and zero field. Least-index selection is canonical and independent of x, Kx, epsilon and data. No product-existence theorem or choice axiom is needed beyond the supplied process/basis. Existing countable-choice use remains confined to the optional negative-Sobolev clause.
exact_claim_repair.null_set_qualification: Equality is almost sure for each fixed parameter and finite list of test vectors. No simultaneous uncountable-index path equality, almost-sure full-partial-sum convergence claim, or H-valued infinite-dimensional observation is asserted.
exact_claim_repair.preserved: Existing independent normal coordinate laws, L2 reconstruction, negative-Sobolev Borel Gaussian realization with its original basis/delta>1/2/countable-choice restrictions, non-L2 caveat, and coordinate diagram are preserved. The diagram still commutes by finite linearity and is not a proof premise.
